Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.reporting

Class EmailAuditReportBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.reporting.EmailAuditReportBuilder
public final class EmailAuditReportBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder that constructs a fully structured per-email section inside an existing ExtentTest node created by ReportManager.

Section anatomy

  ExtentTest (file-level, owned by ReportManager)
   │
   ├─ [Header block]  file metadata + status badge
   │
   ├─ [Evidence block]  embedded screenshot(s) with caption
   │
   ├─ [Category node]   e.g. ACCESSIBILITY
   │    ├─ [Rule node]  ACCESSIBILITY_AXE  →  PASS / FAIL / ERROR
   │    │    ├─ Duration + status line
   │    │    └─ Finding detail rows (FAIL / ERROR only)
   │    └─ …
   │
   ├─ [Category node]   e.g. CONTENT
   │    └─ …
   │
   └─ [Summary block]  metrics table + severity breakdown

Usage


 EmailAuditReportBuilder.forTest(fileTest)
     .withFileName("welcome.html")
     .withFilePath(path)
     .withResults(ruleResults)
     .withScreenshot(screenshotPath)
     .withAdditionalEvidence("Axe JSON", axeJson)
     .build();

Architecture contract

This class only reads RuleResult values — it never invokes rule logic. It delegates final ExtentTest writes to ReportManager conventions for status colours and HTML escaping.

Thread safety

Each builder instance is single-use and single-threaded: one instance is created per file on the file-processing thread, fully configured, and then build() is called once. The ExtentTest node passed in must already have been created under ReportManager's lock. No shared mutable state exists after construction.
